article_name: Allied Health Sciences Courses In Karnataka: Top Courses And Best Colleges 2025
author: @Careermudhra_

content.text: Dear students, if you are looking to start your career in the field of healthcare other than MBBS, then allied health sciences is the perfect choice for you. There are different specializations of courses in Allied health sciences. These Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka cover a wide range of disciplines that help bridge the gap between diagnosis, therapy, and patient support. Allied health sciences refers to a wide group of healthcare professions that are distinct from medicine and nursing, and yet crucial to patient care and recovery. From diagnosis to therapy, from medical imaging to cardiac care technology, allied health professionals support smooth functioning of healthcare systems.

In Karnataka, a fast growing advancing state in terms of medical infrastructure and academic innovation, there are a number of reputed institutions offering BSc Allied health sciences. These courses are modified to prepare the students for employment in hospitals, diagnostic labs, and clinical places. With a strong importance for hands-on training, internships and clinical relevance, Karnataka is emerging as a top destination for students who wish to start a prominent career in allied health care. In this guide, we will explore all the Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, their top colleges, admission process and fee structure in detail.

sections.heading: Contents
Why Choose Karnataka for Allied Health Sciences

content.text: Karnataka is a leading center for medical and allied health sciences education in India. Karnataka’s capital Bangalore is known for its quality education and world class medical institutions and hospitals, making it a preferred choice for students to study. Other than Bangalore, cities like Mangalore, Mysore, Tumkur also have developed educational hubs and universities offering different allied health sciences courses.

In India, Karnataka is known for its modern and advanced infrastructure, quality education, modern labs and student environment. In Karnataka, a major number of institutions affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS) provides high quality education. Other than RGUHS, there are some deemed universities also there with multi speciality hospital tie-ups. Karnataka is known for its research programs, innovation and employment. Students also get opportunities to work in international healthcare.

Due to the presence of more than 150 colleges offering Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, students have access to quality education, infrastructure, and placement opportunities across major cities.

sections.heading: Overview of Allied health sciences courses

content.text: Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka are becoming increasingly popular due to rising demand in healthcare services and growing opportunities in both government and private sectors. Allied health sciences courses are designed to make a skilled professional to work efficiently in a healthcare environment. These programs cover diagnosis, technical, therapy and support services in healthcare. BSc Allied health sciences courses have a duration of three years of academic learning followed by a compulsory internship of six months to one year based on the course and university.

To study BSc Allied health in Karnataka, students must complete 10+2 with Physics, chemistry and biology as mandatory subjects. A minimum percentage of 45% to 50% marks is required. Some institutions may also conduct their own entrance exams or interviews for selection. Students will learn both theoretical and practical classes. Classes are conducted with advanced lab facilities even before they start their internships. These courses are recognized by Paramedical Board of Karnataka and most of the colleges are affiliated to RGUHS. After completion of allied health sciences, students are awarded a bachelor degree that qualify them to work as allied health professionals.

sections.heading: Courses in Allied Health Sciences

content.text: In Karnataka, there are different specializations in Allied health sciences where students can explore and choose on their respective interests.

sections.heading: BSc Cardiac Care Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Bsc cardiac care technology is one of the most in-demand Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka due to its high placement rate and scope in critical care. Because of its future career opportunities, students are interested in pursuing cardiac care technology. It focuses on cardiovascular medicine. These programs include subjects which are mainly focuses on echocardiography, electrocardiography, cardiac anatomy and catheterization techniques. After three years course and internship students will be able to work in ICU, assisting cardiac surgery and emergency wards.

sections.heading: BSc Operation Theatre Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: BSc in Operation Theatre Technology is among the key Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, ideal for students who want to work in real-time surgical settings. Students are trained to assist the surgeons during the time of operations by maintaining OT hygiene handling sterilizing equipment, surgical instruments and operation procedures. Students are also learn about infection control, anesthetics and monitor the patients. After the successful completion of course, students will work in specialty clinics, surgical units and trauma centers.

sections.heading: BSc Anesthesia and critical care – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Anesthesia and Critical Care is a vital Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka that prepares students for emergency and ICU environments. This course is focusing on the administration and monitoring of anesthesia during the surgery and intensive care treatments. In this course students will learn about anesthetic agents, ventilator management and patient assessment. This course is more relatable in today’s medical environment, critical care is becoming an essential part of the treatment protocols. After completing the course, students will be able to work in emergency wards, ICU, trauma care and assist with anesthesiologists in operation theatres.

sections.heading: BSc Respiratory Therapy – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Respiratory Therapy is one of the rapidly growing Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, especially after the COVID-19 pandemic. This courses is focusing on teaching the students about respiratory conditions like COPD, Asthma and more respiratory health issues. Respiratory courses helps students to learn about giving chest physiotherapy, managing artificial airways and handling ventilator. As respiratory conditions such as asthma, COPD, and post-COVID complications increase, the need for trained respiratory therapists is also growing. Respiratory therapy is used in ICU and emergency wards. This course also led the students to learn how to assist and manage oxygen therapy for patients with respiratory insufficiencies.

sections.heading: BSc Medical Imaging Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Medical Imaging is a highly in-demand Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka for students interested in diagnostic radiology. Medical Imaging Technology is focusing on teaching the use of diagnostic imaging equipment like CT scans, X rays, MRI, ultrasound machines. Students are taught to how to use these machines, positioning the patients in machines correctly, interpret results in collaboration with radiologists. The course curriculum also includes image processing techniques, radiation safety tips and anatomy. After completing the course, students will be able to work in diagnostic labs, radiology departments, even they pursue specialized training in radiodiagnosis or nuclear medicine.

sections.heading: BSc Medical Laboratory Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Medical Laboratory Technology is one of the core Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, essential for clinical diagnostics and pathology labs. This trains the students to do laboratory tests on biological specimens such as blood and tissues. It is a important step of disease diagnosis and monitoring. Students will learn microbiology, clinical pathology, hematology and biochemistry. After the successful completion of course, students will be work on diagnostic labs, blood banks, research centres and pathology labs.

sections.heading: BSc Renal Dialysis Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Renal Dialysis is an important Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka, with increasing demand due to lifestyle-related diseases. Renal Dialysis Technology focuses on the procedures and techniques involved in renal dialysis treatment for patients with kidney failure. In this course, students will gain practical knowledge about hemodialysis machines, water treatment systems, patient monitoring and also learn how to handle emergency during dialysis. Nowadays, due to the improper lifestyle diseases like diabetes and hypertension, the number of dialysis is increasing. After graduation, students will work in dialysis and nephrology clinics and hospitals.

sections.heading: BSc Optometry – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Optometry is a specialized Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka focused on visual health and eye care practices. In this course students will learn about eye care and visual health. Students are trained to vision test, prescription of corrective lens, eye examination and management of ocular diseases. Optometrists are work in both clinical and community places where they helps to prevent and manage the vision impairment. This course also includes practical sessions in eye hospitals and optical clinics.

sections.heading: BSC Perfusion Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Perfusion Technology stands out as a unique Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka, focused on cardiac surgeries and heart-lung machines. In Perfusion technology course, students will learn about how to operate heart lung machines during major surgeries particularly cardiac surgeries. This course also covers physiology, pathology, anatomy and mechanics of extracorporeal circulation. Students will be trained to monitor the blood circulation and notice the flow of oxygen, and to manage cardiopulmonary bypass systems. After completing the three years course and internship, they will work with surgical team for critical procedures, open heart surgery and transplantation of organs.

sections.heading: BSc Radiotherapy Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Radiotherapy is one of the specialized Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, tailored for cancer treatment using precision technology. In this course, students will learn about administering the radiation treatments for cancer patients. They will get knowledge about physics, oncology and radiation safety. Students will get hands on experience in advanced equipments like simulators, CT simulators, linear accelerators and therapy machines. This training helps them to deliver the radiation doses in precision and manage radiation related protocols. After course completion students will work in oncology departments and cancer hospitals to assist oncologists in treatments.

sections.heading: How to Get Admission in BSc Allied Health Sciences Courses in Karnataka

content.text: Admission to most Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka is based on 12th marks without NEET, through KEA or direct college applications.

items: After declaration of 12th results, apply in https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/ and submit your application with required details.
The counselling date will be announced based on your scores. Attend the counselling in respective date and choose the college alloted for your mark.
After counselling completion, students have to visit the respective colleges before the alloted date and pay the fees.
For Management quota, the admission process will be done by applying through college.
Fill the form in the respective college website and choose the course.
Pay the fees and secure your seat.

sections.heading: Future Career Opportunities for Allied Health Sciences

content.text: Graduates from Allied health programs are qualified to work in government and private hospitals, emergency response units, imaging centers, diagnostic labs and rehabilitation facilities. As the healthcare field in India continues to expand, the job opportunities for trained technologists, technicians and therapists are increasing.

Depends on the specialization, students will work as cardiac care specialists, Radiographers, dialsys technologists, OT assistants, optometrists, respiratory therapists or medical lab technologists. They also have chance to work in research units and development units or they can start their higher education.

The salary for allied health graduates ranges from 2.5 LPA to 4 LPA for freshers. With experience and further qualifications, professionals can expect salary range of 5LPA to 8LPA in their respective fields.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
What is the duration of BSc Allied Health courses in Karnataka?

content.text: The typical duration of these courses is 3 years of academic instruction followed by a compulsory internship of 6 months to 1 year, depending on the specialization and institution.

sections.heading: Do I need to appear for NEET to get admission in BSc Allied Health courses?

content.text: NEET is not required for admission into BSc Allied Health Sciences courses. Most colleges admit students based on their 10+2 marks or through direct admission.

sections.heading: What is the minimum eligibility to apply for these courses?

content.text: Students must have completed 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology as core subjects. A minimum of 45% to 50% aggregate marks is usually required.

sections.heading: Are these courses recognized by the government?

content.text: Are these courses recognized by the government? Yes, most BSc Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka are affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS) or other recognized universities and are approved by relevant paramedical boards.

sections.heading: Which are the most in-demand allied health specializations in Karnataka?

content.text: Specializations like Cardiac Care Technology, Medical Imaging Technology, Anesthesia & Critical Care, and Medical Laboratory Technology are highly in demand due to their relevance in modern healthcare settings.

sections.heading: Can I get direct admission in private colleges?

content.text: Yes, many private institutions in Karnataka offer direct admission based on Class 12th marks without the need for an entrance exam.

sections.heading: What kind of job roles can I get after completing this course?

content.text: Graduates can work as cardiac technologists, medical lab technologists, OT technicians, dialysis technologists, respiratory therapists, radiographers, or optometrists in various healthcare settings

sections.heading: What is the average salary for allied health graduates in Karnataka?

content.text: Fresh graduates can expect a starting salary of INR 2.5 to 4 lakh per annum. With experience and further qualifications, salaries can go up to INR 8 lakh or more.

sections.heading: Can I pursue higher education after this course?

content.text: Yes, students can pursue M.Sc. in Allied Health Sciences, MBA in Hospital Administration, or postgraduate diploma courses for advanced career opportunities.

sections.heading: Are there job opportunities abroad for allied health graduates?

content.text: Yes, allied health professionals are in demand in countries like the UK, UAE, Canada, and Australia, provided they clear the necessary licensing or certification exams.

content.text: Over 150+ colleges in Karnataka, including government and private institutions, offer BSc Allied Health Sciences courses.

sections.heading: Is BSc Allied Health a good career option in Karnataka?

content.text: Yes, with increasing demand in diagnostic labs and hospitals, BSc Allied Health Sciences offers high employability and job security in Karnataka.

Overview of Allied health sciences courses

Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka are becoming increasingly popular due to rising demand in healthcare services and growing opportunities in both government and private sectors. Allied health sciences courses are designed to make a skilled professional to work efficiently in a healthcare environment. These programs cover diagnosis, technical, therapy and support services in healthcare. BSc Allied health sciences courses have a duration of three years of academic learning followed by a compulsory internship of six months to one year based on the course and university.

To study BSc Allied health in Karnataka, students must complete 10+2 with Physics, chemistry and biology as mandatory subjects. A minimum percentage of 45% to 50% marks is required. Some institutions may also conduct their own entrance exams or interviews for selection. Students will learn both theoretical and practical classes. Classes are conducted with advanced lab facilities even before they start their internships. These courses are recognized by Paramedical Board of Karnataka and most of the colleges are affiliated to RGUHS. After completion of allied health sciences, students are awarded a bachelor degree that qualify them to work as allied health professionals.

Courses in Allied Health Sciences

In Karnataka, there are different specializations in Allied health sciences where students can explore and choose on their respective interests.

BSc Cardiac Care Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Bsc cardiac care technology is one of the most in-demand Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka due to its high placement rate and scope in critical care. Because of its future career opportunities, students are interested in pursuing cardiac care technology. It focuses on cardiovascular medicine. These programs include subjects which are mainly focuses on echocardiography, electrocardiography, cardiac anatomy and catheterization techniques. After three years course and internship students will be able to work in ICU, assisting cardiac surgery and emergency wards.

BSc Operation Theatre Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

BSc in Operation Theatre Technology is among the key Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, ideal for students who want to work in real-time surgical settings. Students are trained to assist the surgeons during the time of operations by maintaining OT hygiene handling sterilizing equipment, surgical instruments and operation procedures. Students are also learn about infection control, anesthetics and monitor the patients. After the successful completion of course, students will work in specialty clinics, surgical units and trauma centers.

BSc Anesthesia and critical care – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Anesthesia and Critical Care is a vital Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka that prepares students for emergency and ICU environments. This course is focusing on the administration and monitoring of anesthesia during the surgery and intensive care treatments. In this course students will learn about anesthetic agents, ventilator management and patient assessment. This course is more relatable in today’s medical environment, critical care is becoming an essential part of the treatment protocols. After completing the course, students will be able to work in emergency wards, ICU, trauma care and assist with anesthesiologists in operation theatres.

BSc Respiratory Therapy – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Respiratory Therapy is one of the rapidly growing Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, especially after the COVID-19 pandemic. This courses is focusing on teaching the students about respiratory conditions like COPD, Asthma and more respiratory health issues. Respiratory courses helps students to learn about giving chest physiotherapy, managing artificial airways and handling ventilator. As respiratory conditions such as asthma, COPD, and post-COVID complications increase, the need for trained respiratory therapists is also growing. Respiratory therapy is used in ICU and emergency wards. This course also led the students to learn how to assist and manage oxygen therapy for patients with respiratory insufficiencies.

BSc Medical Imaging Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Medical Imaging is a highly in-demand Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka for students interested in diagnostic radiology. Medical Imaging Technology is focusing on teaching the use of diagnostic imaging equipment like CT scans, X rays, MRI, ultrasound machines. Students are taught to how to use these machines, positioning the patients in machines correctly, interpret results in collaboration with radiologists. The course curriculum also includes image processing techniques, radiation safety tips and anatomy. After completing the course, students will be able to work in diagnostic labs, radiology departments, even they pursue specialized training in radiodiagnosis or nuclear medicine.

BSc Medical Laboratory Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Medical Laboratory Technology is one of the core Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, essential for clinical diagnostics and pathology labs. This trains the students to do laboratory tests on biological specimens such as blood and tissues. It is a important step of disease diagnosis and monitoring. Students will learn microbiology, clinical pathology, hematology and biochemistry. After the successful completion of course, students will be work on diagnostic labs, blood banks, research centres and pathology labs.

BSc Renal Dialysis Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Renal Dialysis is an important Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka, with increasing demand due to lifestyle-related diseases. Renal Dialysis Technology focuses on the procedures and techniques involved in renal dialysis treatment for patients with kidney failure. In this course, students will gain practical knowledge about hemodialysis machines, water treatment systems, patient monitoring and also learn how to handle emergency during dialysis. Nowadays, due to the improper lifestyle diseases like diabetes and hypertension, the number of dialysis is increasing. After graduation, students will work in dialysis and nephrology clinics and hospitals.

BSc Optometry – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Optometry is a specialized Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka focused on visual health and eye care practices. In this course students will learn about eye care and visual health. Students are trained to vision test, prescription of corrective lens, eye examination and management of ocular diseases. Optometrists are work in both clinical and community places where they helps to prevent and manage the vision impairment. This course also includes practical sessions in eye hospitals and optical clinics.

BSC Perfusion Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Perfusion Technology stands out as a unique Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka, focused on cardiac surgeries and heart-lung machines. In Perfusion technology course, students will learn about how to operate heart lung machines during major surgeries particularly cardiac surgeries. This course also covers physiology, pathology, anatomy and mechanics of extracorporeal circulation. Students will be trained to monitor the blood circulation and notice the flow of oxygen, and to manage cardiopulmonary bypass systems. After completing the three years course and internship, they will work with surgical team for critical procedures, open heart surgery and transplantation of organs.

BSc Radiotherapy Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Radiotherapy is one of the specialized Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, tailored for cancer treatment using precision technology. In this course, students will learn about administering the radiation treatments for cancer patients. They will get knowledge about physics, oncology and radiation safety. Students will get hands on experience in advanced equipments like simulators, CT simulators, linear accelerators and therapy machines. This training helps them to deliver the radiation doses in precision and manage radiation related protocols. After course completion students will work in oncology departments and cancer hospitals to assist oncologists in treatments.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the duration of BSc Allied Health courses in Karnataka?

The typical duration of these courses is 3 years of academic instruction followed by a compulsory internship of 6 months to 1 year, depending on the specialization and institution.

Do I need to appear for NEET to get admission in BSc Allied Health courses?

NEET is not required for admission into BSc Allied Health Sciences courses. Most colleges admit students based on their 10+2 marks or through direct admission.

What is the minimum eligibility to apply for these courses?

Students must have completed 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology as core subjects. A minimum of 45% to 50% aggregate marks is usually required.

Are these courses recognized by the government?

Are these courses recognized by the government? Yes, most BSc Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka are affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS) or other recognized universities and are approved by relevant paramedical boards.

Which are the most in-demand allied health specializations in Karnataka?

Specializations like Cardiac Care Technology, Medical Imaging Technology, Anesthesia & Critical Care, and Medical Laboratory Technology are highly in demand due to their relevance in modern healthcare settings.

Can I get direct admission in private colleges?

Yes, many private institutions in Karnataka offer direct admission based on Class 12th marks without the need for an entrance exam.

What kind of job roles can I get after completing this course?

Graduates can work as cardiac technologists, medical lab technologists, OT technicians, dialysis technologists, respiratory therapists, radiographers, or optometrists in various healthcare settings

What is the average salary for allied health graduates in Karnataka?

Fresh graduates can expect a starting salary of INR 2.5 to 4 lakh per annum. With experience and further qualifications, salaries can go up to INR 8 lakh or more.

Can I pursue higher education after this course?

Yes, students can pursue M.Sc. in Allied Health Sciences, MBA in Hospital Administration, or postgraduate diploma courses for advanced career opportunities.

Are there job opportunities abroad for allied health graduates?

Yes, allied health professionals are in demand in countries like the UK, UAE, Canada, and Australia, provided they clear the necessary licensing or certification exams.

How many colleges offer Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka?

Over 150+ colleges in Karnataka, including government and private institutions, offer BSc Allied Health Sciences courses.

Is BSc Allied Health a good career option in Karnataka?

Yes, with increasing demand in diagnostic labs and hospitals, BSc Allied Health Sciences offers high employability and job security in Karnataka.
